What I'd tell a brand team

  • Early buzz is common, not a green light. Search interest was at least a little higher, compared with the brand, before RISE comebacks (STRONG by more than 15%), including FADED of the ones that faded.
  • What I'd test next: does demand hold? A limited run or a few regions might show whether people come back after the first spike.
  • Also next: judge it after launch. What happens once the novelty wears off may say more than the noise before it.

The first point is exploratory: found after the test, so it is a lead to check, not a result. The other two weren't tested here.
